fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Long Driveway; Open Terrain; Limited Rear Access
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance visible from both directions of travel on the street.
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective posts or delineators to define the entry point, particularly in low-light or smoky conditions.
• Keep the access drive clear of parked vehicles, equipment, and debris along its full length to allow two-way emergency vehicle movement.
• If the access drive is too narrow for two vehicles to pass, identify and mark a pull-out area along the drive where a vehicle can yield to an oncoming emergency unit.
• Post the property address at the point where the driveway meets the street, not only at the residence, to reduce search time along a long drive.
• Install a gate or driveway chain that can be quickly opened from the outside without a key, or provide lock-box access for emergency responders.
• Keep the surface of the access drive maintained so emergency vehicles can reach the residence without becoming stuck or high-centered.
• Identify and mark a staging area near the residence large enough for an emergency vehicle to turn around without backing the full length of the driveway.
• If a rear gate or access point to the rear of the property exists within the perimeter fencing, keep it unlocked or clearly marked for responder use.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Shrubs; Open Terrain; Structure Cluster; Long Driveway; Vegetation Along Driveway; Scattered Shrubs; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Water Feature; Scattered Trees; Scattered Shrubs; Open Green Space; Scattered Shrubs
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim trees and shrubs along the driveway so branches do not hang over or crowd the travel lane.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against or immediately next to any structure in the cluster.
• Thin shrubs scattered near the structures to increase open space between plants and buildings.
• Keep the full length of the driveway clear of low-hanging branches to allow unobstructed vehicle access.
• Remove dead or dry material from shrubs located close to the structures.
• Separate shrub groupings near the structure cluster so plants are not touching or nearly touching each other.
• Keep grass and low ground cover around the structures mowed short during dry periods.
